title: ScenarioProvenance
description:
Companion of a what-if [`ScenarioInput`]: where its inputs came from, the seeding stated as
an assumption, and every parameter's citation. A scenario is only published beside a
companion for which [`ScenarioProvenance::check_against`] holds.

excluded_nodes.description: Counties the neighbourhood rule would have simulated but could not.

neighbourhood_note.description: Why the node set is what it is (non-empty).

nodes.description: The simulated nodes, in the scenario's canonical order.

parameters.description: One entry per `SeirParameters` field, in field order (non-empty, unique).

seed.description: The scenario's RNG seed as decimal text (a JavaScript number would round a large u64).

statement.description: Plain-words statement of what the scenario is and is not (non-empty).

ExcludedNode.description: A county the neighbourhood rule would have simulated but could not, and why.

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded

MmwrWeek.description: An MMWR year and week number (`week` is `1..=52` or `1..=53`).

week.description: Week of the MMWR year; 1 to 52, or 53 in a 53-week year.

year.description: MMWR year (not always the calendar year of every day in the week).

NodeInputs.description: What a node's inputs are, beyond the source records the scenario already carries.

coverage_school_year.description: School year of the baseline kindergarten MMR coverage, e.g. `2023-24`.

ParameterProvenance.description: One model parameter exactly as the scenario ran it, with its citation (#1400).

note.description: What the source supports and what it does not (non-empty).

url.description: Where to read it, when the source is a public page.

value.description: The value the scenario ran with, as it appears in the scenario's `parameters`.

SeedingAssumption.description:
How the scenario is seeded: a stated assumption, never data. The scenario is a
hypothetical introduction, not a reconstruction of an observed outbreak.

geography.description:
The geography the infectious people are introduced into; every other node starts
with no exposed or infectious people.

initial_exposed.description: Exposed (latent) people at the start week.

initial_infectious.description: Infectious people at the start week.

limitation.description: What the seeding cannot capture, stated to the reader (non-empty).

start_week.description:
The week the simulation starts, stated as an assumption (not derived from any case
report).

start_week_basis.description: Why this start week, and what it does and does not mean (non-empty).
